description: Single-quarter income for one FDIC-insured bank, 2018-03 to 2026-06: the official quarterly net income as published by the FDIC, plus the naive year-to-date difference with a flag where the two disagree (for example merger pushdown accounting). Give the FDIC cert number and either one quarter (default latest) or a start-end range; merger events are attached when recorded. Industry totals reconstructed from these institution values match the FDIC Quarterly Banking Profile in 106 of 136 quarter-metric checks; the 30 exceptions sit in 8 quarters between 2020-06 and 2023-09 (all Q2 or Q4 except 2023-09) and every row in those quarters carries the label does_not_reconcile_to_qbp with the exact industry residual per metric. Nothing is forced to balance. One bank per call; no rankings. For credit unions use cu_quarter_income.
name: bank_quarter_income
